_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4). Based on games-steamcmd astroneer/egg-astroneer-dedicated-server.json (pelican-eggs, MIT licence). Octail fixes the config edits ({{server.environment.X}} instead of {{env.X}}, Octail's section.key form instead of [section].key, the URL section's case, no PlayerProperties line that overwrote the server's player list), writes Engine.ini and AstroServerSettings.ini in the install when they are missing (so the edits land from the first start, with encryption off, which Proton needs), and adds the astroneer tag, the no_console_input flag (Proton reads no commands), install sandbox defaults and resource hints, makes the public IP optional (empty = the allocation's IP when it isn't 0.0.0.0, else the address api.ipify.org sees, as AstroLauncher does: the server does not start without one) and checked as an IP, shows the engine log (Astro/Saved/Logs/Astro.log) on the console and detects the start from it (upstream's start line was a Wine notice printed before the game runs), the owner name and Guid optional, refuses double quotes and backslashes in the names, turns the Proton debug log off (it grows by gigabytes), waits for the server when the stop (Ctrl+C) arrives so the container ends with it (the game ignores Ctrl+C under Proton: after 30 s it gets SIGTERM, or it was killed when the stop timed out), and makes the install fail when SteamCMD didn't download the server. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times: its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration". The start also counts once the game port (UDP) is bound (x_octail.features.ready): under Proton Astro.log can stay empty, so the start lines may never show. SteamCMD exits 0 even when an install failed (Missing configuration), so its retry loop counts a run as done only on SteamCMD's "Success! App" line.
name: Astroneer
author: melethainiel.aerin@gmail.com
description: A game of aerospace industry and interplanetary exploration.
startup: if [ -z "${PUBLIC_IP}" ]; then ASTRO_IP=${SERVER_IP}; if [ -z "${ASTRO_IP}" ] || [ "${ASTRO_IP}" = "0.0.0.0" ]; then ASTRO_IP=$(curl -fsS --max-time 10 https://api.ipify.org || true); fi; if [[ ${ASTRO_IP} =~ ^[0-9]{1,3}(\.[0-9]{1,3}){3}$ ]]; then echo "Octail: Public IP is empty, using ${ASTRO_IP}."; sed -i "s/^PublicIP=$/PublicIP=${ASTRO_IP}/" Astro/Saved/Config/WindowsServer/AstroServerSettings.ini; else echo "Octail: set Public IP on the Startup tab; without it the server does not start."; fi; fi; proton run ./Astro/Binaries/Win64/AstroServer-Win64-Shipping.exe & ASTRO_PID=$!; tail -c0 -F ./Astro/Saved/Logs/Astro.log --pid=${ASTRO_PID} 2>/dev/null & trap "for i in $(seq 1 30); do kill -0 ${ASTRO_PID} 2>/dev/null || break; sleep 1; done; pkill -TERM -f AstroServer-Win64-Shipping 2>/dev/null; wait ${ASTRO_PID}" INT TERM; wait ${ASTRO_PID}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# steamcmd Base Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Image to install with is 'ghcr.io/parkervcp/installers:debian'
# Install packages. Default packages below are not required if using our existing install image thus speeding up the install process.
#apt -y update
#apt -y --no-install-recommends install curl lib32gcc-s1 ca-certificates
## just in case someone removed the defaults.
if [[ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]] || [[ "${STEAM_PASS}" == "" ]]; then
echo -e "steam user is not set.\n"
echo -e "Using anonymous user.\n"
STEAM_USER=anonymous
STEAM_PASS=""
STEAM_AUTH=""
else
echo -e "user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi
## download and install steamcmd
## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Install steamcmd"
echo "-----------------------------------------"
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd
# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server
## install game using steamcmd
## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Install game"
echo "-----------------------------------------"
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} $( [[ "${WINDOWS_INSTALL}" == "1" ]] && printf %s '+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows' ) +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) ${INSTALL_FLAGS} validate +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log && grep -q "Success! App '" /tmp/steamcmd.log && ! grep -q "ERROR! Failed to install app" /tmp/steamcmd.log; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done
## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/Astro/Binaries/Win64/AstroServer-Win64-Shipping.exe" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the Astroneer dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so
## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so
## Octail: the config files exist from the first start (Octail edits them before every start); the server needs
## encryption off to run under Proton
mkdir -p /mnt/server/Astro/Saved/Config/WindowsServer
if [[ ! -f /mnt/server/Astro/Saved/Config/WindowsServer/Engine.ini ]]; then
    printf '[URL]\nPort=7777\n\n[SystemSettings]\nnet.AllowEncryption=False\n' > /mnt/server/Astro/Saved/Config/WindowsServer/Engine.ini
elif ! grep -q "^net.AllowEncryption=" /mnt/server/Astro/Saved/Config/WindowsServer/Engine.ini; then
    printf '\n[SystemSettings]\nnet.AllowEncryption=False\n' >> /mnt/server/Astro/Saved/Config/WindowsServer/Engine.ini
fi
if [[ ! -f /mnt/server/Astro/Saved/Config/WindowsServer/AstroServerSettings.ini ]]; then
    printf '[/Script/Astro.AstroServerSettings]\nPublicIP=\nServerName=\nOwnerName=\nOwnerGuid=\nServerPassword=\n' > /mnt/server/Astro/Saved/Config/WindowsServer/AstroServerSettings.ini
fi

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Public IP
variables.description: The server's public IPv4 address, which players connect to. Empty = the server's own IP when it has one (not 0.0.0.0), else the address api.ipify.org sees. The server does not start without one.

variables.name: Server Owner Name
variables.description: Optional but recommended: the Steam name of the server owner, who becomes its admin.

variables.name: Server Owner Guid
variables.description: Optional: the owner's Guid; Astroneer fills it in when the owner first joins.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: If specified, players must provide this password to join the server.

variables.name: Automatic Updates
variables.description: Quickly checks for any server updates on startup, and updates if necessary. (1 Enable | 0 Disable)

variables.name: PROTON_LOG
variables.description: Proton's debug log (steam-728470.log). Off: it grows by gigabytes.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The server name (up to 60 characters, no double quotes or backslashes).
